# Why is Tencent stock falling today?

Editor Ambar Warrick Stock Markets

Editor Ambar Warrick

Published Nov 12, 2026, 01:46 AM

Why is Tencent stock falling today?

© Reuters.

Investing.com -- Tencent Holdings Ltd stock slipped 1.2% to HK$404.8 on Thursday after a report emerged that the U.S. Commerce Department is moving to finalize rules that would prevent Chinese AI companies from remotely accessing advanced semiconductors through data centers located outside China.

The proposed measures, which could be announced as early as this month, would extend existing semiconductor export controls to seven additional countries — including Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand — effectively closing an offshore workaround that Chinese tech giants have relied upon to access cutting-edge AI compute capacity.

The regulatory headline arrives at a particularly sensitive moment for Tencent, which is just days away from reporting its third-quarter earnings on November 18. Analysts at CLSA and Huayuan Securities have flagged that the company’s accelerated AI spending — spanning model training, its WorkBuddy enterprise agent, and the Xiaowei consumer assistant — could pressure Q3 margins.

The broader Hong Kong market was under pressure as well, with the Hang Seng Index declining roughly 0.9% to around 24,092 points by midday, dragged lower by the same chip-access restriction report that hit Tencent. Sector peer Alibaba was a sharper decliner in the same session.

# What Investors Got Wrong About Tencent Before The Drop

Mitch Lawler November 15, 2026, 20:21 UTC

If you had backed Tencent on the promise of AI driven growth, heavier cloud usage and new monetisation inside WeChat, the past year has probably felt jarring. For Tencent shareholders, the loss over the past year was 39.0%, including dividends. The business still reported higher revenue and profit in recent quarters, so what exactly did the original case miss about margins, chip access and AI spending intensity that were already visible risks in late 2025, yet underweighted?

## The Two Tencent Stories Investors Were Pricing In

The shares cost HK$656 at the start of the period, leaving Tencent investors weighing two very different stories about what came next.

On the optimistic side, one thesis set a Fair Value of HK$814, a price implied by assumptions that Tencent could lift revenue by 15.0% with profit margins at 31.0%, backed by Weixin Video Accounts, games and AI tools such as Hunyuan.

A more cautious view pointed to a Fair Value of HK$508, based on Tencent only reaching 12.0% revenue growth, 24.0% profitability and tighter future regulation around data and gaming.

## What The Tencent Evidence Actually Tested

Tencent poured money into AI, with Q2 2026 results showing revenue at CNY204.8b and net income at CNY56.0b while net margin slipped from 30.2% to 27.4%. Heavy capital spending on chips and models, along with cancelled overseas chip leasing and intermittent H200 shipments, challenged the higher margin path in the optimistic case. The evidence cut both ways.

The lesson is simple. When an investment pitch leans on AI efficiency and strong margins, track reported net margin and disclosed AI capex together, not just headline revenue or product launches.

### Key Takeaways

- Alibaba’s Hong Kong shares fell as much as 7.3% after a report said Washington will stop Chinese firms from renting advanced chips in overseas data centers.
- Bloomberg reported that Alibaba rents Nvidia chips through Megaspeed International, which is why the selloff hit it harder than Tencent.
- Cloud revenue rose 45% last quarter, but CEO Eddie Wu tied faster growth to more supply, and the reported rule targets exactly that supply.
- The September-quarter report on November 19 will show whether cloud growth is still speeding up and how Alibaba plans to secure compute.

Alibaba Group (BABA) walked into earnings week with a fresh problem. Its Hong Kong shares slumped as much as 7.3% on November 12, dragging the Hang Seng Tech Index lower.

The trigger was a report from The Information. Commerce Department officials are preparing to finalize rules that would stop Chinese AI firms from remotely using advanced chips housed in overseas data centers.

That hit Alibaba harder than its peers. Bloomberg reported that it rents Nvidia (NVDA) chips through Megaspeed International, a Singapore firm caught up in a widening controversy around Nvidia. Meanwhile, Tencent (TCEHY) slipped just 1.5% in Hong Kong while Alibaba was down 5%.

The timing is awkward. Two days earlier, Alibaba disclosed that its T-Head chip unit had confidentially filed for a Hong Kong IPO.

## Washington targets rented compute

Here is what the reported rule would do:

- Extend existing chip export controls to seven more countries, including Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand.
- Close a gap that lets Chinese firms rent processors they cannot legally import.
- Arrive as soon as this month.

Megaspeed adds a second layer of risk. U.S. agencies have investigated the company for more than a year, according to the WSJ, and it has denied any illegal chip transfers.

None of this touches the processors T-Head designs in-house. Still, investors were already wary before Thursday…

Alibaba Group (BABA) is no longer just the Chinese online shopping giant most investors remember. T-Head, Alibaba's homegrown chip design unit founded in 2018, develops data center processors and AI chips to support the company's growing ambitions in AI computing.

T-Head is also expected to remain under Alibaba's umbrella after the listing.
Until now, T-Head's value has been tucked inside Alibaba Cloud, making it difficult for investors to figure out how much this chip business is really worth. The timing is hardly boring either, with U.S.-China chip tensions back in the headlines, growing demand for homegrown AI processors, and the recent Nvidia (NVDA)-related controversy adding more attention to the semiconductor space.

- HSBC is considering a more independent role for its Singapore operations alongside its Hong Kong franchise.
- The review is part of a broader effort to simplify the regional structure and diversify Asian exposure.

HSBC is considering greater independence for its Singapore operations as it seeks to diversify its Asian footprint. Ad Hoc News reported the development on Thursday, November 12, citing The Edge.

HSBC plans to combine its major banking services in Singapore under one entity over the next few years. The bank is also weighing whether additional regional activities could move under the Singapore subsidiary, potentially giving the city a larger role alongside Hong Kong.

## Singapore could become a second hub

The review, known internally as Project Sirena, remains fluid and does not represent a final decision. Surendra Rosha, HSBC's co-CEO for Asia and the Middle East, confirmed the planned combination of the separate Singapore units as part of a simplification drive, while saying there were no further plans at this stage.

Hong Kong remains HSBC's main Asian profit center, while Singapore is an important wealth and banking hub. A broader Singapore role could reduce organizational complexity and diversify the group's regional exposure, but execution and the eventual allocation of activities remain key considerations for investors.

## Capital returns remain in focus

The Singapore review adds a strategic angle to the bank's unchanged 2026 targets and capital-return plans. # Samsung Falls 3%, SK hynix 5% on NAND Price Slide

DRAM Price Outlook Kept Intact

Published 2026.11.16. 10:57:50

By Kim Byung-joon econ_jun@sedaily.com

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix corporate logos. Seoul Economic Daily DB

Samsung Electronics (005930) and SK hynix (000660), both flat early in the session, deepened their losses and dragged down the KOSPI. Analysts attribute the shift to souring sentiment after Bank of America told the market that NAND flash prices are falling.

Samsung Electronics traded at 198,900 won, down 7,100 won or 3.45% from the previous session, while SK hynix fell 63,000 won or 5.18% to 1,153,000 won, according to the Korea Exchange on the 16th. SK Square (402340) changed hands at 707,500 won, down 54,500 won or 7.15%. The weakness in Samsung Electronics and SK hynix pushed the KOSPI down by nearly 3%.

Heavy selling by foreign investors intensified the decline, led by chip stocks. Foreign investors were net sellers of 759.8 billion won on the main board. Retail investors net bought 474.1 billion won and institutional investors 157.3 billion won.

The market slid as analysts said expectations for the NAND segment of the memory market need to be dialed back. In a report, Bank of America noted that NAND spot prices have fallen nearly 20% since October. The bank singled out NAND as the first product in the upcycle that warrants lower expectations, pointing to continued slowing orders from smartphone makers and Chinese cloud providers.

Bank of America also stressed that there has been no reduction in orders for chips used in U.S. artificial intelligence data centers, including those from Samsung Electronics, while noting that its outlook for NAND used in IT devices is less optimistic than for enterprise SSDs. As a result, the market sees pricing power in NAND shifting from sellers to buyers.

The bank kept a positive view on DRAM. It said it was maintaining its existing forecast that DRAM prices will rise a further 8% in the fourth quarter of this year and 5% in the first quarter of next year. Differences in exposure to DRAM and NAND could drive a clearer divergence in share prices, it said.

# Samsung, SK hynix account for more than one-fourth of Korea's stock market credit loans 

 With investors in the two chipmakers holding nearly 7 trillion won in outstanding credit loans, or 27.2 percent of the total across the Kospi and Kosdaq, concerns have grown over broader market volatility. 

 News Team News Team 

 Published November 15, 2026 - 3:29 p.m. 

SK hynix headquarters in Icheon, Gyeonggi, on Oct. 28

NEWS1

More than one-fourth of credit loans in Korea’s stock market are concentrated in just two major semiconductor manufacturers’ stocks — Samsung Electronics and SK hynix.

Analysts say investors’ heavy reliance on borrowed money to buy shares in Korea’s chip giants has amplified volatility across the entire market, not just for the two stocks.

Investors held 3.64 trillion won ($2.73 billion) in outstanding credit loans for Samsung Electronics and 3.33 trillion won for SK hynix as of Thursday, market tracker FnGuide said Sunday. 

Together, the two stocks accounted for 6.97 trillion won in outstanding credit loans, or 27.2 percent of the 25.6 trillion won total across the Kospi and Kosdaq.

On the Kospi alone, Samsung Electronics and SK hynix accounted for 36.5 percent of the market’s 19.09 trillion won in outstanding credit loans.

Outstanding credit loans measure the money investors still owe brokerages for stock purchases and serve as a key gauge of debt-fueled stock trading in the market.

Korea’s stock market has had few precedents for such an outsize share of leveraged investment in just two companies.

The two chipmakers’ combined share of total credit loan balances was far smaller in recent years, at an average of 3.39 percent in 2020, 4.39 percent in 2021, 4.36 percent in 2022 and 2.71 percent in 2023. Their share of outstanding credit loans climbed to 5.37 percent in 2024 before reaching 6.73 percent in 2025.

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix corporate logos. Seoul Economic Daily DB

Samsung Electronics (005930) and SK hynix (000660), both flat early in the session, deepened their losses and dragged down the KOSPI. Analysts attribute the shift to souring sentiment after Bank of America told the market that NAND flash prices are falling.

Samsung Electronics traded at 198,900 won, down 7,100 won or 3.45% from the previous session, while SK hynix fell 63,000 won or 5.18% to 1,153,000 won, according to the Korea Exchange on the 16th. SK Square (402340) changed hands at 707,500 won, down 54,500 won or 7.15%. The weakness in Samsung Electronics and SK hynix pushed the KOSPI down by nearly 3%.

Heavy selling by foreign investors intensified the decline, led by chip stocks. Foreign investors were net sellers of 759.8 billion won on the main board. Retail investors net bought 474.1 billion won and institutional investors 157.3 billion won.

The market slid as analysts said expectations for the NAND segment of the memory market need to be dialed back. In a report, Bank of America noted that NAND spot prices have fallen nearly 20% since October. The bank singled out NAND as the first product in the upcycle that warrants lower expectations, pointing to continued slowing orders from smartphone makers and Chinese cloud providers.

Bank of America also stressed that there has been no reduction in orders for chips used in U.S. artificial intelligence data centers, including those from Samsung Electronics, while noting that its outlook for NAND used in IT devices is less optimistic than for enterprise SSDs. As a result, the market sees pricing power in NAND shifting from sellers to buyers.

The bank kept a positive view on DRAM. It said it was maintaining its existing forecast that DRAM prices will rise a further 8% in the fourth quarter of this year and 5% in the first quarter of next year. Differences in exposure to DRAM and NAND could drive a clearer divergence in share prices, it said.

 [서울=뉴시스] 전신 기자 = 코스피가 0.28% 오른 5305.40으로 개장한 16일 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 전광판에 코스피 등이 표시돼 있다. 2026.11.16. [email protected] 

[서울=뉴시스]임다빈 기자 = 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 견조한 실적 전망에도 인공지능(AI) 투자 둔화 우려로 주가 조정을 겪으면서 반등 여부에 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 이번 주 미국 AI 기업 앤트로픽의 기업공개(IPO)와 엔비디아 실적 발표가 투자심리 회복의 분수령이 될지 주목된다.

16일 금융투자업계에 따르면 반도체 '투톱' 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 조정장을 맞이하고 있다. 지난 13일 삼성전자는 전일 대비 2000원(0.96%) 내린 20만6000원, SK하이닉스는 3만8000원(3.03%) 떨어진 121만6000원에 거래를 마쳤다.

증권가에서는 최근 주가 조정에도 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 실적 성장세가 이어질 것으로 보고 있다. 다만 향후 주가 흐름을 두고는 엇갈린 전망이 나온다.

LS증권은 두 기업의 4분기 실적이 사상 최대치를 기록할 것으로 예상하며 목표주가를 각각 45만원, 240만원으로 유지했다. 정우성 LS증권 연구원은 서버용 D램 공급 부족과 고대역폭메모리(HBM)4 출하 확대가 양사의 실적 성장을 이끌 것으로 전망했다.

정 연구원은 삼성전자에 대해 "올해 서버 D램의 잠재 수요 대비 공급 충족률은 40% 미만에 불과하다"며 "데이터센터 투자 일부가 지연되더라도 기존 초과수요를 고려하면 단기간 내 메모리 시장이 공급과잉으로 전환될 가능성은 제한적이라고 판단한다"고 말했다.

SK하이닉스에 대해서도 HBM4 공급 확대와 주주환원 여력을 근거로 긍정적인 전망을 유지했다. 정 연구원은 "SK하이닉스 역시 막대한 현금창출 능력과 주주환원 확대 여력을 고려하면 중장기 투자 매력이 높은 구간이라는 판단이다. 시간은 매수자의 편이라는 입장이다"고 전했다.

반면 모건스탠리는 지난 9일 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 목표주가를 각각 38만1000원에서 30만9000원으로 19%, 260만원에서 160만원으로 38% 낮췄다. 내년 영업이익 전망치는 각각 9%, 13% 상향했지만, 2027년 말 신규 생산시설 가동에 따른 메모리 공급 증가와 데이터센터 투자 지연 가능성을 우려했다.

숀 킴 모건스탠리 연구원은 "내년 실적보다 2028년 이후 성장세 유지 여부에 대한 우려가 커지고 있다"고 설명했다.

이처럼 증권가의 주가 전망이 엇갈리는 배경에는 향후 AI 투자 지속성에 대한 불확실성이 자리하고 있다. 시장에서는 AI 투자 확대에 따른 단기 실적 성장뿐 아니라 중장기 수익성에 대한 신뢰가 회복돼야 위축된 반도체주 투자심리도 개선될 수 있다는 분석이 나온다.

이런 가운데 오는 19일(현지시간) 나스닥 상장을 추진 중인 미국 AI 기업 앤트로픽의 IPO가 반도체주 투자심리를 가늠할 변수로 떠오르고 있다. 앞서 지난 11일에도 앤트로픽 상장 기대감이 국내 반도체주에 긍정적으로 작용하면서 삼성전자는 3.57%, SK하이닉스는 5.36% 상승 마감한 바 있다.

앤트로픽은 미국 증권거래위원회(SEC)에 제출한 예비 증권신고서에서 희망 공모가를 주당 70~78달러로 제시했다. 공모 주식 수는 8억2500만주로, 공모가 상단 기준 모집 규모는 643억5000만달러에 달한다. AI 기업에 대한 투자 수요를 확인할 대형 IPO인 만큼 공모 흥행 여부와 상장 이후 주가 흐름에 시장의 관심이 쏠린다.

이에 앞서 17일(현지시간) 예정된 엔비디아의 실적 발표도 AI 투자 지속성을 확인할 주요 일정으로 꼽힌다. 시장에서는 향후 데이터센터 수요와 차세대 GPU 공급 전망을 주목 중이다.

증권가에서는 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 실적 성장 전망이 유지되고 있는 만큼 두 이벤트를 통해 AI 투자 둔화 우려가 완화될 경우 주가 반등을 모색할 수 있다는 분석이 나온다.

김대준 한국투자증권 연구원은 "금주 대외 이벤트가 많지만 가장 중요한 건 엔비디아 실적 발표와 앤트로픽 신규 상장"이라며 "투자심리와 증시 수급에 직접적인 영향을 미친다"고 했다.

이어 "앤트로픽의 공모가가 최대치 78달러로 결정되고 상장일에 상승 마감한다면 AI 모멘텀은 유지될 수 있다"며 "업황 개선과 수급 불안 해소는 약세 분위기를 바꾸는데 기여할 전망"이라고 덧붙였다.

Shares Flat as Gains and Losses Alternate

Published 2026.11.16. 08:35:55

By Kim Byung-joon econ_jun@sedaily.com

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Yonhap News

Shares of Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK hynix (000660.KS) are trading flat as investors hold back ahead of major events that could shape sentiment toward artificial intelligence investment, including Nvidia's earnings report and Anthropic's initial public offering.

In premarket trading on Nextrade between 8 a.m. and 8:50 a.m. on November 16, Samsung Electronics traded at 205,000 won, down 1,000 won or 0.49% from the previous session, while SK hynix traded at 1.21 million won, down 6,000 won or 0.49%. Both stocks have alternated between gains and losses to stay largely unchanged.

Analysts said investors are waiting for Nvidia's earnings release scheduled for the 17th, the minutes of the October Federal Open Market Committee meeting due on the 19th, and the market reception for Anthropic's IPO.

Nvidia's fourth-quarter guidance and gross margin are expected to set the direction for chip stocks and the broader index. The key questions are whether revenue guidance exceeds the $123.3 billion to $124.5 billion range and whether the company posts a gross margin of 74%.

Remarks from Federal Reserve officials should offer clues on the path of interest rates. Attention is focused on comments by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at a conference on productivity and employment scheduled for the 16th. If officials conclude that AI is contributing to productivity gains, expectations for price stability could grow and ease concerns about the need for further rate increases.

Anthropic's listing this week will serve as a gauge of how strong enthusiasm for AI investment remains. The company is taking subscriptions at an indicative price range of $70 to $78 per share, with the final offering price set for the 18th and the Nasdaq debut on the 19th. After cutting its valuation target to about $1.2 trillion from an initially expected $2 trillion, Anthropic's proposed offering price is seen as fairly attractive given its growth outlook.

"The market is expected to gain stability as investors confirm Nvidia's earnings and the FOMC minutes," said Lee Kyoung-min, an analyst at Daishin Securities (003540.KS).

The shares cost ₩58,100 at the start of the period, and anyone looking at Kakao then had to decide which story about its future felt more believable. 

The bullish case saw Kakao as a future super app, with a Fair Value of ₩86,333, a price implied by assumptions that AI driven services and immersive ad products could support revenue climbing 13.0% a year and margins rising to 10.6% by 2028.

# [단독] 현대차, 하이브리드 승부수...열효율 45% ’린번 엔진’ 꺼냈다

By

[EBN 김경현 기자]

현대자동차가 파워트레인 경쟁력 강화를 위해 ’엔진 효율’이라는 승부수를 던졌다. 연료보다 공기를 더 많이 넣어 태우는 ’린번(희박연소)’ 방식으로 최고 열효율 45%를 달성한 하이브리드 전용 엔진을 통해서다.

16일 EBN 산업경제 취재를 종합하면 현대차는 최근 ’균질 희박연소 하이브리드(HOMOGENEOUS LEAN BURN HYBRID)’를 적용한 SUV(스포츠 유틸리티 차량) 차량을 시험하고 있는 것으로 확인됐다.

이 차량은 차세대 엔진을 탑재해 ’효율적이면서 배출가스 영향이 없는(Efficient with zero impact emissions)’ 것을 구현한다. 앞서 지난해 6월 현대차는 세계자동차공학회(SAE)에서 논문을 통해 이번 기술을 공개한 바 있다.

구체적인 제원은 흡기 포트와 피스톤 형상을 바꾸고 고에너지 다중 점화를 적용해 연소 불안정을 잡았고, 공기 과잉률 2.0 이상에서 최고 열효율 45%를 기록했다.

린번 엔진 특유의 출력 저하 문제는 전동식 슈퍼차저로 보완했다. 공기량을 정밀 제어하는 전동식 슈퍼차저를 하이브리드 모터와 결합해 중형(D세그먼트) SUV 구동에 필요한 동력 성능을 확보했다.

린번 엔진 상용화의 가장 큰 난제였던 질소산화물(NOx) 과다 배출 문제는 후처리 장치로 대응했다. 현대차는 연소 최적화로 질소산화물 발생 자체를 2000rpm·8.5bar 조건에서 0.3g/kWh 이하로 줄였다. 여기에 질소산화물 흡장 촉매(LNT)와 수동형 선택적 촉매 환원(pSCR) 장치를 결합했다.

다른 논문에서도 이 시스템을 장착한 린번 하이브리드 차량은 향후 강화될 배출가스 규제를 충족하면서 연비를 10% 개선했다고 명시했다. 차체에 새겨진 ’배출가스 영향 제로’ 문구와 맞닿아 있는 대목이다.

현대차가 린번 카드를 꺼낸 것은 모터·배터리 용량 증대라는 물리적 방식을 넘어, 엔진 본연의 효율 극대화로 미래 하이브리드 시장 주도권을 쥐겠다는 전략으로 풀이된다.

이에 대해 현대차 관계자는 "내부 개발 계획 및 구체적인 차량 제원 등 자세한 내용은 확인해 주기 어렵다"고 전했다.

업계 관계자는 "모터와 배터리만으로 하이브리드 연비를 높이는 데는 원가 및 중량 증가라는 뚜렷한 한계가 존재한다"며 "기존 내연기관의 열효율 한계를 누가 먼저 깨느냐가 하이브리드 시장의 핵심 경쟁력이 될 것이다"고 진단했다.

 Hyundai Motor Group appears to have settled on continuing with a management structure centered on José Muñoz, president and CEO of Hyundai Motor Company, in a decision seen as reflecting the performance of its North American business and the need for management stability. Muñoz is currently focused on cutting costs and running the North American business, while Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Euisun Chung oversees the group’s operations as a whole, including its domestic business. According to people in the auto industry on the 11th, Hyundai Motor has reportedly settled on retaining its current management structure centered on Muñoz in its regular year-end executive reshuffle. Rumors of Muñoz’s replacement surfaced around the middle of this year, but Chairman Chung appears to have opted for stability over a management shake-up. Muñoz is the first foreign CEO in Hyundai Motor’s history. Since taking office in January 2025, he has focused on cutting costs and improving management efficiency. He has also overseen the North American region. The results are reflected in revenue. Hyundai Motor’s North American revenue in the first half of this year was 44.8404 trillion won, up 9.4% from 40.9902 trillion won in the same period a year earlier. It accounted for 47.1% of total revenue of 95.1542 trillion won, nearly half. By contrast, domestic revenue fell 7.2% over the same period, from 28.2289 trillion won to 26.1849 trillion won. Revenue in Europe also rose only slightly, from 12.2981 trillion won to 12.3423 trillion won. The North American market was, in effect, the main driver of growth in overall sales. The problem, however, is profitability. Hyundai Motor’s consolidated revenue in the first three quarters of this year rose 0.6% from a year earlier, but operating profit fell 17.7%. With profitability weakening despite growth in the North American market, assessments of Muñoz’s performance as a leader are mixed. The main reasons cited are the burden of U.S. auto tariffs and higher costs resulting from expanded local production. # Kona and Sportage to undergo major changes… Hyundai Motor and Kia set to launch wave of new flagship models next year

By Kang Juheon

Hyundai Motor’s “The All-New Tucson.” /Photo provided by=Hyundai Motor

The Hyundai Motor Group is set to turn around its sales performance next year by leading with new models for its key vehicles. Given that Hyundai Motor’s sales had stalled this year due to production disruptions and sluggish demand, the company plans to boost results by successively introducing fully redesigned models to major domestic and overseas markets.

According to industry sources on the 16th, Hyundai Motor is scheduled to release a fully redesigned Kona model and the Genesis GV70 hybrid vehicle in the domestic market in the first half of next year. In the second half, it will sequentially unveil a facelifted Sonata model, an electric Kona, and the Avante N. Kia plans to launch its Purpose-Built Vehicle (PBV) PV7 and facelifted K5 and Morning models in the first half. The facelifted K5 model, set for release in March, is expected to be the first Kia vehicle to be equipped with the next-generation infotainment system, Pleos Connect, following Hyundai Motor’s Grandeur and Avante.

The core of Kia’s second-half lineup next year will be the sixth-generation Sportage. Kia plans to begin domestic mass production in July, followed by sequential launches in Europe in October-November and in the United States in December. The fuel efficiency of the hybrid vehicle is expected to improve by 5-6% compared to the existing model.

Kia’s “PV7.” /Photo provided by=Kia

The fully redesigned Kona model will join the lineup in the second half.
